name: Minnesota Supply Company
tagline: A Minnesota supplier that sources and makes products for the Supply Lab.
about: Minnesota Supply Company is a student-run firm in the OPMT 375 Supply Lab. We source materials and make products for other teams in our chain. Our offerings may change once the class settles on an industry.
how_to_order: Open an issue in this repository's Issues tab. Include the item name, quantity, and delivery needs, and we will reply in the same issue.
